plain: A researcher named David said on Jesse Michels's podcast that two experimenters, Charles and Drew, have been testing devices that push using static electricity, in a lab with a shielded cage and a vacuum chamber. He describes their claim that you power the device up, unplug it from the wall, and the thrust keeps going on and on, which, if true, would point to a kind of propulsion that needs no ongoing power.
